research_goal: Develop a coherent AI and robotics/industrial systems doctoral programme with a core thesis and an independently doctoral-scale extension. Produce six distinct English SCI/SCIE manuscripts targeting at least three current JCR Q1 journals and at least Q2 for the rest, using public or authorized data and cloud computation. Prepare a credible doctoral application dossier by August 2027; editorial acceptance is outside the project’s control.
researcher_background: Mechanical engineering and Big Data/BI training, with Python, machine learning, data analysis and industrial application experience. Researcher to review this summary.
preferred_domains: AI for robotics and industrial systems
candidate_application_routes: PhD by publication where legally and institutionally available
equipment: No institutional laboratory, physical prototype, or local GPU is assumed. GitHub Actions standard Linux runners execute the cloud workflow.
data_constraint: Use public or explicitly authorized, versioned datasets with verified licenses and provenance; do not upload restricted or identifying data to a public runner.
excluded_domains: Projects requiring a physical laboratory, costly equipment, or dedicated local GPU
ethics_or_legal_constraints: Respect dataset and full-text licenses, privacy, provider terms, and research-use rights.
notes: PROPOSED G0 DRAFT: all time, effort, and budget figures and ranking weights require researcher review. This file is not a paid-run authorization or human gate approval.

Application milestone: August 2027. Stretch goal: up to three scientifically independent manuscripts submitted or submission-ready by month six, subject to evidence and quality gates. Complete the six-manuscript programme within 18 months; journal acceptance cannot be scheduled or guaranteed.

Initial cash ceiling proposal: USD 300 total, including up to USD 100 of external cloud compute; standard public-repository GitHub Actions runners are the default. Publication fees, travel and paid data are excluded and require a separate decision.

The existing model ceiling in config/defaults.json is CNY 300 for the project; keep it as a separate, provisional limit within the total cash ceiling. Actual UUAPI model IDs and charges must be verified before each paid cycle.

Codex controls GitHub cloud jobs. Claude API supplies read-only planning and independent criticism; OpenAI API writes persistent research artifacts. No local WSL2, Docker, Python, GPU, RAM or storage is required for this workflow.
